name: MakerBot Method 0.4 nozzles
machine_start_gcode:
G90 ; use absolute coordinates
M83 ; extruder relative mode
M104 S[first_layer_temperature] T0 ; set extruder 0 temp
M104 S[first_layer_temperature] T1 ; set extruder 1 temp
M140 S[first_layer_bed_temperature] ; set bed temp
G28 ; home all axes
M190 S[first_layer_bed_temperature] ; wait for bed temp
M109 S[first_layer_temperature] T0 ; wait for extruder 0 temp
G1 Z10 F3000 ; raise nozzle
G92 E0.0
machine_end_gcode:
G91 ; relative positioning
G1 E-1.0 F2100 ; retract
G92 E0.0
G1 Z10 F3000 ; move print head up
G90 ; absolute positioning
M104 S0 T0 ; turn off extruder 0
M104 S0 T1 ; turn off extruder 1
M140 S0 ; turn off heatbed
M107 ; turn off fan
G1 X0 Y105 F3000 ; park print head
M84 ; disable motors
